headword: {倍速再生|ばいそくさいせい}

definitions.explanation: Playing back audio or video at a speed faster than normal, typically at twice the original speed. Used widely when watching lectures, podcasts, or recorded content to save time.

examples.japanese: {倍速再生|ばいそくさいせい}で{動画|どうが}を{見|み}る。
examples.english: To watch a video at double speed.

examples.japanese: {講義|こうぎ}の{録画|ろくが}を{倍速再生|ばいそくさいせい}で{聞|き}いた。
examples.english: I listened to the recorded lecture at double speed.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}の{若者|わかもの}はドラマも{倍速再生|ばいそくさいせい}で{見|み}るらしい。
examples.english: Apparently young people these days watch even dramas at double speed.

notes:
A compound of {倍速|ばいそく} (double speed) + {再生|さいせい} (playback). This term has become very common in the streaming age, with the trend of watching content at accelerated speed becoming a cultural talking point in Japan. The practice is especially common among students and busy professionals.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {倍速再生|ばいそくさいせい}で{見|み}る: to watch at double speed
- {倍速再生|ばいそくさいせい}{機能|きのう}: double-speed playback function
- 1.5{倍速|ばいそく}{再生|さいせい}: 1.5x speed playback
- 2{倍速|ばいそく}{再生|さいせい}: 2x speed playback

RELATED WORDS:
- {再生|さいせい}: playback — normal-speed playback
- {早送|はやおく}り: fast forward — skipping ahead through content
- {スロー再生|すろーさいせい}: slow-motion playback
